dismissed_comment: False positive. This API is bearer-only and STATELESS: cookies, query/form tokens and servlet sessions cannot authenticate; no auth cookie/session is issued; hostile-Origin mutation is refused. Reassess if ambient auth or CORS/Origin rules change.

rule.name: java/spring-disabled-csrf-protection
rule.full_description: Disabling CSRF protection makes the application vulnerable to a Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attack.

message.text: CSRF vulnerability due to protection being disabled.
